message.content: Fix one finding on change 279 (PR 481, branch `feat/scheduler-priority-and-cancel`, trail 405). `git fetch origin`; start from `origin/feat/scheduler-priority-and-cancel` (475a708a); local branch `fix/cancel-running-request`; commit locally; I push. Read /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/worker-contract.md, then `entire trail finding show 01M7H245ZYB7 --branch feat/scheduler-priority-and-cancel --repo gh/orin-dx/caliper --project gh/orin-dx`, crates/core/src/pipeline/semantic_hook.rs (~190-300: cancel, `find`, pending entries) and crates/semantic/src/on_demand.rs (~355: the worker finishing a request). The finding: if navigation cancels a neighbour request that is ALREADY being converted, the hook removes its pending entry though the worker still finishes it; requesting that component again before completion makes `find` create a duplicate request; the original delivery settles only the old waiter, so a foreground caller waits for another conversion. Fix: track whether conversion has started (the worker marks the shared request as running when it takes it) and make cancel preserve the pending entry (and not drop its waiters) for a running request; cancel only removes still-queued ones. Keep the diff small, no new abstractions. Tests first (fail on base): cancel after the worker took the request keeps the entry and a second request for the same key joins it (no duplicate conversion, one delivery settles both waiters); cancel before the worker takes it still drops it; the earlier tests stay green. Gates (targeted): `pnpm install --offline --ignore-scripts --frozen-lockfile` in the worktree first; `just lint doc-check machete typos`; nextest `-p caliper-docgen-semantic -p caliper-docgen-core`. Then `/code-review low` once and AWAIT its output; fix only real bugs.
